stageNoteLink.text: Happy to talk it through — message me and we'll choose together.

attributes.label: What will you use them for?

attributes.question: What will you use them for?
attributes.intro: Your prescription tells you which. If there's an “ADD” column on it, varifocal is probably what you're after.

options.label: Distance
options.helpText: Uses the main line of your prescription. This is what most people want in sunglasses — sharp vision looking ahead and into the distance.

options.label: Reading
options.helpText: For reading in the garden or by the pool. Uses the “ADD” value on your prescription. You won't want to drive in these.

options.label: Varifocal
options.description: Near and far in one lens, no line.
options.helpText: Distance at the top, reading at the bottom, blended in between with no visible line. Usually for over-40s. I take the fitting measurements from a photo or in person.

options.label: No prescription
options.description: Keep the lenses they come with.
options.helpText: Adds the frame to your bag exactly as the brand made it, with its original tinted lenses. You can always add prescription lenses later.

attributes.label: How thin would you like them?

attributes.question: How thin would you like them?
attributes.intro: Thinner lenses are lighter and sit neater in the frame. If you don't know your numbers, Standard is a safe pick — I'll check when your prescription arrives and tell you if something thinner is worth it.

options.label: Standard · 1.5
options.description: Fine for most prescriptions up to about ±2.00.
options.helpText: The standard lens material. Perfectly good for a mild prescription — going thinner would make no visible difference and cost you money for nothing.

options.label: Thin · 1.6
options.helpText: Noticeably slimmer at the edge and lighter on your nose. The usual choice once your prescription gets past about ±2.00.

options.label: Extra thin · 1.67
options.helpText: Worth it for a stronger prescription — it stops the lens edge standing proud of the frame and reduces the way strong lenses distort how your eyes look.

options.label: Ultra thin · 1.74
options.description: The thinnest made. For ±6.00 and above.
options.helpText: The thinnest lens material available. If your prescription is strong, this is the difference between glasses you want to wear and glasses you tolerate.

attributes.question: What finish?
attributes.intro: All of them block 100% of UV and come scratch-resistant. Watch the frame on the left change as you pick.

options.label: Tinted to match
options.description: Same colour and depth as the original lenses.
options.helpText: I match the tint to the lenses the brand fitted, so the frame looks exactly as designed. Nobody will know they're prescription.

options.label: Polarised
options.description: Kills glare off water, roads and windscreens.
options.helpText: A filter that cuts reflected glare rather than just dimming everything. If you drive a lot or spend time near water, this is the upgrade worth paying for.

options.label: Light-reactive
options.description: Clear indoors, dark outside in under a minute.
options.helpText: One pair that works indoors and out. Worth knowing they react to UV, so they stay lighter behind a car windscreen.

options.label: Clear
options.helpText: Sunglasses frames make excellent everyday glasses. Anti-reflective coating both sides, included.

attributes.question: Your prescription
attributes.eyebrow: Last bit — and it can wait
attributes.intro: It needs to be under two years old and from a UK optician — whoever tested your eyes has to give you a copy if you ask. You don't need it to hand right now.

options.label: Send it later
options.description: Order now and I'll WhatsApp you a link for it. Nothing gets made until it arrives.

options.label: Upload a photo
options.description: A phone photo of the paper copy is fine.

options.label: Type it in
options.description: If you've got the numbers in front of you.

attributes.heading: Perfect — order now and I'll WhatsApp you a link for it.
attributes.body: I make the lenses once it arrives, nothing is charged twice, and if you change your mind before I cut them I refund the lenses in full.

attributes.label: Drop a photo or screenshot here

attributes.body: Copy the numbers exactly, including the + or −. If a box is empty or says “DS”, leave it blank. I read every prescription myself before anything is cut.
